test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Lose your touch

options.text: Doing someone a favour in hopes that the favour will be returned
To be passed from one person to another
Not being as successful as previously
Something being very difficult to find

solution:
The correct answer is '**Not being as successful as previously'.**
